content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 3.4(b) conditions our convenience termination on paying uncapped "early termination charges" specified in Attachment A and Service Option Attachments — a Customer-payable liquidated amount with no ceiling and no statement that it is exclusive, which fails the LD fallback. Late payment fees (§4.2) and the §9.2 liability cap are not liquidated damages and were not flagged.

**Cure (fallback level):** a single short sentence inserted after §3.4(b) capping those charges at three (3) months' charges and making them the sole liquidated amount payable by us. We chose the fallback over deleting §3.4(b) because §3.3 expressly cross-refers to "the early termination charges described in Section 3.4(b)," so deletion would leave a dangling reference.
